seed.title: Basic Internet Subscription Setup
seed.description: This Blueprint defines an address-based internet subscription and installation workflow. The system checks port availability using the location's infrastructure number, ending immediately if unavailable. If available, the user selects a compatible speed package, a port is allocated, an order is created, and the user is notified before the port is configured and physically connected to complete the setup.
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
bbk = GetBBKByAddress(User.Address)
inventory = GetInventory(bbk)
IF inventory.Available == TRUE THEN
    products = GetProductBySpeed()
    selectedProduct = WaitForUserSelection(products)
    CreateOrder(selectedProduct, User.Address)
END_IF
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

seed.description: Find product, assign compliance certificate, create purchase order, write process to LLM, and send email.

product = FindProduct(selectedProduct)
AssignCertificate(product.id)
PO.Create(product.id)
LLM.WriteProcess()
Email.Send()
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

seed.title: Meeting Recording Transcription & Summary
seed.description: Converts per-participant PCM recordings to WAV, transcribes each one, produces a structured meeting summary attributed by speaker ID (key topics, decisions, action items), resolves participant IDs to real names in that summary, and emails the summary to all participants.
seed.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
ConvertPCMToWAV(directoryPath)
transcripts = TranscribeMeeting(directoryPath)
summary = SummarizeMeetingBySpeaker(transcripts.speaker_transcripts)
resolved = ResolveParticipants(summary, participants)
Email.Send(to: participants.emails, subject, body: resolved)
Complete()
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

properties.description: Convert all PCM audio files in the meeting directory to WAV format
properties.label: Convert PCM to WAV

properties.description: Transcribe each WAV file individually and collect per-speaker transcripts
properties.prompt: Transcribe all WAV files in the meeting directory
properties.label: Transcribe Meeting

properties.description: Produce a structured meeting summary (key topics, decisions, action items) attributed by speaker ID, using each participant's individual transcript
properties.prompt: Pass speaker_transcripts from the previous step through unchanged to produce a speaker-attributed meeting summary
properties.label: Summarize Meeting By Speaker

properties.description: Replace numeric participant IDs with real participant names, anywhere they appear in the meeting summary
properties.prompt: Resolve participant IDs to real names in the meeting summary using meeting metadata
properties.label: Resolve Participants
properties.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
resolved = ResolveParticipants(summary, participants)
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

properties.description: Email the resolved meeting summary to all meeting participants
properties.prompt: Send one email to all meeting participants (join every participant's email from meeting metadata into a comma-separated 'to' field). Use the meeting name/date in the subject. Format the body from the resolved summary: overall summary, key topics, decisions, action items (with owner names), and per-speaker highlights.
properties.label: Send Email
properties.pseudocode:
BEGIN_CONTEXT
Email.Send(to: participants.emails, subject, body: resolved)
END_CONTEXT

END_MESSAGE

properties.description: Mark the meeting transcription and summary workflow as complete
properties.label: Complete
